comments.body: I've heard that ETHZ is crazy competitive (by friends who went there but choose to quit), such that creating (and maintaining) real friendship is difficult, unless you already know people there. Also, those students aren't there to socialize because the work load is immense, except if you're some kind of genius. Mandatory fluency in german is also required because the courses won't be taught in english unless it's in the 3rd year or so. If you're looking for a university which teaches the whole curriculum in english, you shouldn't stay in switzerland. E.g. the Netherlands would be a much better option. Instead of going to EPFL and your french is already B2, maybe look into a FH, if you plan to stay in switzerland? Most jobs do not care if you got your architecture's degree at EPFL or  a FH anyway here in Switzerland (and they're on par internationally), but you might have to do a year long internship to gather working experience to enter a FH.
comments.author: Cloudy-weather
